versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֤לֶּה הָיוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י דָויִ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר נֽוֹלַד־ל֖וֹ בְּחֶבְר֑וֹן הַבְּכ֣וֹר׀ אַמְנֹ֗ן לַאֲחִינֹ֨עַם֙ הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִ֔ית שֵׁנִי֙ דָּנִיֵּ֔אל לַאֲבִיגַ֖יִל הַֽכַּרְמְלִֽית׃

controles.web: Now these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;
controles.kjv: Now these were the sons of David, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:
controles.livre: Estes são os filhos de Davi, que lhe nasceram em Hebrom: Amnom, o primogênito, de Ainoã Jezreelita; o segundo Daniel, de Abigail de Carmelo;

versos.hebraico: הַשְּׁלִשִׁי֙ לְאַבְשָׁל֣וֹם בֶּֽן־מַעֲכָ֔ה בַּת־תַּלְמַ֖י מֶ֣לֶךְ גְּשׁ֑וּר הָרְבִיעִ֖י אֲדֹנִיָּ֥ה בֶן־חַגִּֽית׃

controles.web: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;
controles.kjv: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:
controles.livre: O terceiro, Absalão, filho de Maaca, filha de Talmai, rei de Gesur; o quarto, Adonias, filho de Hagite;

versos.hebraico: הַחֲמִישִׁ֥י שְׁפַטְיָ֖ה לַאֲבִיטָ֑ל הַשִּׁשִּׁ֥י יִתְרְעָ֖ם לְעֶגְלָ֥ה אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:
controles.kjv: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.
controles.livre: O quinto, Sefatias, de Abital; o sexto, Itreão, de sua mulher Eglá.

versos.hebraico: שִׁשָּׁה֙ נֽוֹלַד־ל֣וֹ בְחֶבְר֔וֹן וַיִּ֨מְלָךְ־שָׁ֔ם שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֑ים וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וְשָׁלוֹשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס

controles.web: six were born to him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months. In Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years;
controles.kjv: These six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.
controles.livre: Estes seis lhe nasceram em Hebrom, de onde reinou sete anos e seis meses; e em Jerusalém reinou trinta e três anos.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֥לֶּה נוּלְּדוּ־ל֖וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑יִם שִׁ֠מְעָא וְשׁוֹבָ֞ב וְנָתָ֤ן וּשְׁלֹמֹה֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה לְבַת־שׁ֖וּעַ בַּת־עַמִּיאֵֽל׃

controles.web: and these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;
controles.kjv: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath–shua the daughter of Ammiel:
controles.livre: Estes lhe nasceram em Jerusalém: Simeia, Sobabe, Natã, e Salomão, estes quatro de Bate-Sua, filha de Amiel.

versos.hebraico: וְיִבְחָ֥ר וֶאֱלִישָׁמָ֖ע וֶאֱלִיפָֽלֶט׃

controles.web: and Ibhar, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
controles.kjv: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
controles.livre: Nasceram-lhe mais: Ibar, Elisama, Elifelete,

versos.hebraico: וְנֹ֥גַהּ וְנֶ֖פֶג וְיָפִֽיעַ׃

controles.web: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
controles.kjv: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
controles.livre: Nogá, Nefegue, Jafia.

versos.hebraico: וֶאֱלִישָׁמָ֧ע וְאֶלְיָדָ֛ע וֶאֱלִיפֶ֖לֶט תִּשְׁעָֽה׃

controles.web: and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
controles.kjv: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
controles.livre: Elisama, Eliada, e Elifelete, nove.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֖ל בְּנֵ֣י דָוִ֑יד מִלְּבַ֥ד בְּֽנֵי־פִֽילַגְשִׁ֖ים וְתָמָ֥ר אֲחוֹתָֽם׃פ

controles.web: All these were the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.
controles.kjv: These were all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
controles.livre: Todos estes foram os filhos de Davi, exceto os filhos das concubinas. E Tamar foi irmã deles.

versos.hebraico: וּבֶן־שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה רְחַבְעָ֑ם אֲבִיָּ֥ה בְנ֛וֹ אָסָ֥א בְנ֖וֹ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
controles.kjv: And Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
controles.livre: E o filho de Salomão foi Roboão, cujo filho foi Abias, cujo filho foi Asa, cujo filho foi Jeosafá;

versos.hebraico: יוֹרָ֥ם בְּנ֛וֹ אֲחַזְיָ֥הוּ בְנ֖וֹ יוֹאָ֥שׁ בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
controles.kjv: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
controles.livre: Cujo filho foi Jorão, cujo filho foi Acazias, cujo filho foi Joás;

versos.hebraico: אֲמַצְיָ֧הוּ בְנ֛וֹ עֲזַרְיָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ יוֹתָ֥ם בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
controles.kjv: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
controles.livre: Cujo filho foi Amazias, cujo filho foi Azarias, cujo filho foi Jotão;

versos.hebraico: אָחָ֥ז בְּנ֛וֹ חִזְקִיָּ֥הוּ בְנ֖וֹ מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
controles.kjv: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
controles.livre: Cujo filho foi Acaz, cujo filho foi Ezequias, cujo filho foi Manassés;

versos.hebraico: אָמ֥וֹן בְּנ֖וֹ יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בְנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
controles.kjv: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
controles.livre: Cujo filho foi Amom, cujo filho foi Josias.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵי֙ יֹאשִׁיָּ֔הוּ הַבְּכוֹר֙ יוֹחָנָ֔ן הַשֵּׁנִ֖י יְהוֹיָקִ֑ים הַשְּׁלִשִׁי֙ צִדְקִיָּ֔הוּ הָרְבִיעִ֖י שַׁלּֽוּם׃

controles.web: The sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Josiah were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Josias foram: Joanã seu primogênito, o segundo Jeoaquim, o terceiro Zedequias, o quarto Salum.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֖י יְהוֹיָקִ֑ים יְכָנְיָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ צִדְקִיָּ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Jeoaquim foram: seu filho Jeconias, e seu filho Zedequias.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵי֙ יְכָנְיָ֣ה אַסִּ֔ר שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵ֖ל בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,
controles.kjv: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,
controles.livre: E os filhos de Jeconias, o cativo, foram: seu filho Sealtiel,

versos.hebraico: וּמַלְכִּירָ֥ם וּפְדָיָ֖ה וְשֶׁנְאַצַּ֑ר יְקַמְיָ֥ה הוֹשָׁמָ֖ע וּנְדַבְיָֽה׃

controles.web: and Malchiram, and Pedaiah, and Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
controles.kjv: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
controles.livre: Malquirão, Pedaías, Senazar, Jecamias, Hosama, e Nedabias.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֣י פְדָיָ֔ה זְרֻבָּבֶ֖ל וְשִׁמְעִ֑י וּבֶן־זְרֻבָּבֶל֙ מְשֻׁלָּ֣ם וַחֲנַנְיָ֔ה וּשְׁלֹמִ֖ית אֲחוֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel, and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam, and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;
controles.kjv: And the sons of Pedaiah were, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:
controles.livre: E os filhos de Pedaías foram: Zorobabel, e Simei. E os filhos de Zorobabel foram: Mesulão, Hananias, e sua irmã Selomite.

versos.hebraico: וַחֲשֻׁבָ֡ה וָ֠אֹהֶל וּבֶרֶכְיָ֧ה וַֽחֲסַדְיָ֛ה י֥וּשַׁב חֶ֖סֶד חָמֵֽשׁ׃

controles.web: and Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab Hesed, five.
controles.kjv: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab–hesed, five.
controles.livre: E os cinco outros: Hasubá, Oel, Berequias, Hasadias, e Jusabe-Hesede.

versos.hebraico: וּבֶן־חֲנַנְיָ֖ה פְּלַטְיָ֣ה וִישַֽׁעְיָ֑ה בְּנֵ֤י רְפָיָה֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַרְנָ֔ן בְּנֵ֥י עֹבַדְיָ֖ה בְּנֵ֥י שְׁכַנְיָֽה׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah, and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Hananias: Pelatias, e Jesaías, os filhos de Refaías, os filhos de Arnã, os filhos de Obadias, e os filhos de Secanias.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֥י שְׁכַנְיָ֖ה שְׁמַעְיָ֑ה וּבְנֵ֣י שְׁמַעְיָ֗ה חַטּ֡וּשׁ וְ֠יִגְאָל וּבָרִ֧יחַ וּנְעַרְיָ֛ה וְשָׁפָ֖ט שִׁשָּֽׁה׃

controles.web: The sons of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, and Igal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
controles.livre: E o filho de Secanias foi Semaías; e os filhos de Samaías foram seis: Hatus, Igal, Bariá, Nearias, e Safate.

versos.hebraico: וּבֶן־נְעַרְיָ֗ה אֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֧י וְחִזְקִיָּ֛ה וְעַזְרִיקָ֖ם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃

controles.web: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, and Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Nearias foram três: Elioenai, Ezequias, e Azricão.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֣י אֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֗י הדיוהו וְאֶלְיָשִׁ֡יב וּפְלָיָ֡ה וְ֠עַקּוּב וְיוֹחָנָ֧ן וּדְלָיָ֛ה וַעֲנָ֖נִי שִׁבְעָֽה׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Elioenai were, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Elioenai foram sete: Hodavias, Eliasibe, Pelaías, Acube, Joanã, Delaías, e Anani.
